svg.title: valthvn, a portfolio inside a painting
svg.desc: A gilded baroque frame holds an animated night scene after Van Gogh: the Great Bear twinkles over the Rhône, the lights of Arles shimmer on the water, two strollers and two boats rest on the bank. A museum label reads: valthvn, Portfolio, 2026. Vibe coder: web apps, tools and APIs. Build. Learn. Iterate.
svg.text: Vibe coder: web apps, tools and APIs.
